name: Temple Hill Rotundas — surface and detail kit
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Two prominent cream-and-gold circular colonnades under indigo star-pattern domes, broad front steps, blue/gold circular courtyard inlays and cypress perimeter. Isometric suggests another rear rotunda not equally clear in front/mini-plan. Hidden layout inference: Use the visible pair as forecourt anchors, joined by a paved central spine and smaller garden landings. Keep column bays open where source shows depth, with a central framed focal recess rather than infilling every bay. A rear third pavilion is a labelled inferred option pending source parity. Preserve this local design. Exactly12 isolated main components in a clean4-column grid. No missing/empty slots or repeated subjects counted twice. One clear front/three-quarter view with useful small rear/top/contact inset per cell. Truly flat backs for appliques, square join ends for repeat mouldings. Screens have repeated coherent holes, no tangled tendrils. Windows separate glass from surrounds, cornices/parapets and posts separate where named. Do not include large room/scenery fragments attached to a tiny detail. Title "B07-DETAIL-001 — Temple Hill Rotundas — surface and detail kit". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Need circular column/plinth/ring-beam hosts, dome-to-drum seat and radial stair/courtyard joins. Existing source already supplies dome stars, acanthus capitals, urns and mosaic patterns; do not substitute Gothic palace capitals. Cypress/cream flowerbeds; restrained birds/pollinators. Missing detached construction pieces and local interior-facing patterns.
